AYUSH SAXENA +91 7007578720 ⋄ Bengaluru, India ayushsaxena0210@gmail.com ⋄ linkedin.com/in/ayushsaxena210/

OBJECTIVE

Machine Learning Engineer with 4 years of hands-on experience, specialized in applying cutting-edge machine learning algorithms and deep learning architectures to address complex challenges and drive innovation, seeking full-time roles.

EDUCATION

Master of Science in Machine Learning & AI IIIT Bangalore & LJMU

2023 - 2025

Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University 7.16 CGPA

2017 - 2021

SKILLS

Technical Skills

Data Analysis Deployment Cloud Programming Version Control Databases

TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Langchain, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker, OpenAI, LlamaIndex, RAG, CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, GANs, Transformers - LLama, Mistral, GPT, BERT, LLM fine-tuning, Generative AI Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn Docker, Flask, FastAPI, Streamlit, Django GCP, AWS Python, Java, C Git, BitBucket, DVC SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL

EXPERIENCE

Machine Learning Engineer (R&D) NEC Corporation

India

Sep 2021 - Present Bengaluru, India

Led end-to-end machine learning workflows, including data collection, feature engineering, model training, and deployment using Django and Streamlit.

Fine-tuned LLM models for social media text analysis and created efficient inference APIs with Flask.

Contributed to data strategy, identified/integrated new datasets, and collaborated on end-to-end AI/ML projects. Implemented analytical models in production, collaborating seamlessly with software developers.

Communicated analytic solutions to stakeholders and iteratively improved operational systems.

Conducted ideation, contributing to innovative solutions in Healthcare and Smart City domains.

Trainee NEC Corporation

India

Jan 2021 - Aug 2021 Bengaluru, India

Developed predictive models aligned with product owner requirements, collaborating with data scientists, BIEs, and BAs. Executed projects, designing, implementing, and maintaining large-scale ETL processes for a global client.

PROJECTS

AI-Powered Urban Grievance System

Jan 2024 - Present

Developing an AI-driven Grievance Management System for Indian Smart Cities, leveraging GenAI (OpenAI, LLaMA3), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and BERT models. The system captures citizens’ problems from a vast corpus of social media and RSS feed data, enabling city operators to proactively address issues, enhance city maintenance, and improve safety Apr 2023 - Feb 2024

Developing an AI-driven Grievance Management System for Indian Smart Cities, leveraging GenAI (OpenAI, LLaMA3), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and BERT models. Developed an advanced SNS Analysis Tool incorporating high-accuracy BERT & GPT models for sentiment analysis and grievance classification. This tool empowers authorities to efficiently address citizen concerns on platforms like Twitter. Jan 2023 - Aug 2023

This AI-driven solution streamlines medical workflows, utilizing ML algorithms & OpenAI models to structure prescriptions efficiently, save in EMR, and generate insightful graphs for informed decisions.

Risk Analysis Tool

Nov 2021 - Dec 2022

Engineered a comprehensive risk analysis tool for visualizing industry and company-level risks, categorizing them by sentiment and opinion. This tool analyzed real-time news from various sources, facilitating fund managers in efficient risk management.
